system.name: Cure Serious Wounds Rev
system.description:
This spell cures one living (not undead or non-living) creature of 2d6+2 points of damage. The caster can cure themselves with this spell.

Reverse: Cause Serious Wounds inflicts 2d6+2 damage to a touched living (not undead or non-living) target. The target gets no save against the damage, but the caster must make a normal attack roll to touch an unwilling target.
